scope: single-Mother trial for reversible visual controls that mutate renderer, material, visibility, camera or overlay state
trigger: a workflow and final browser state pass while a captured intermediate or restored view remains visually contaminated
assertions: the restore oracle is an immutable snapshot captured before the first transition, not a mutable object that the transition can contaminate
the exact ordered transition sequence is executed and recorded
returning the UI boolean to its initial value is insufficient without equality of every claim-relevant renderer state field
at least one repeated round trip must produce the same state tuple as the original baseline
state tuple equality and painted visual evidence are complementary and neither substitutes for the other
a real visual failure rejects the visual-restoration claim without erasing separately valid numerical or workflow evidence
visual comparison environment and tolerance must be pinned and versioned
